title: OpenAI claims it solved an 80-year-old math problem — for real this time
brief: OpenAI's reasoning model has disproved a geometry conjecture that has been unsolved since 1946, with validation from mathematicians who previously exposed OpenAI's incorrect claims about mathematical breakthroughs. This marks a significant achievement in using AI for advanced mathematical research, though the company's past missteps have raised scrutiny around its claims.
